crop.notes: The clipping is the whole front page at low resolution. The Allen item is 'St. Louisans at the Ring Side', lower part of column 4.

ocr.notes: Transcript is a jumbled round-by-round of McAuliffe-Myer and never mentions Allen. The Allen passage was read only from an enlarged view of the low-resolution page and is blurry.

title.suggested: Allen at ringside for McAuliffe-Myer fight in New Orleans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, "who defeated Mike McCool for the American heavyweight championship," and Tom Kelly were the best-known St. Louisans at the McAuliffe-Myer fight in New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday Evening, September 5, 1892 (Night Extra).

facts.fact: Allen was at ringside in New Orleans for the Jack McAuliffe-Billy Myer lightweight fight, having gone down from St. Louis with Charley and Johnny Daly, "Nobby" Clark and Chris Lauff

notes: Needs a proper crop of 'St. Louisans at the Ring Side' (column 4) and a fresh transcript; names read from a blurry enlargement. The current summary (Allen watching McCoole vs Mace) is wrong.
